title: BenchmarkSuite
description: A reproducible workload shared by every implementation (spec/benchmarks/*.json). Running the same suite in any language on any machine plays exactly the same games.

config.description: Expectimax config (spec/AI.md): depth (int | "auto"), minDepth, maxDepth, fourPruneEmpties, weights. timeBudgetMs makes a suite non-deterministic and is not allowed in shared suites.

seeds.description: Games use seeds start, start+1, …, start+count-1 (uint32 wrap-around).

timeDecisions.description: record per-decision latency (disable for engine-throughput suites)
